$comment: Declarative manifest for tdpdf.com. build/site/build-site.ps1 reads this and nothing else
'source' is relative to this file. A source that points OUTSIDE build/site/ is a repository
document published verbatim: it is read at build time, every time, so the page cannot drift
from the file the application actually ships.
'path' is the URL the page is served at; keep existing ones stable (the app, the Microsoft
Store listing and search engines link to them). 'hero' pages open with their own hero
section, so the layout prints no title above them.
'regenerate' names a script that rebuilds a generated source. It runs only under
build-site.ps1 -Regenerate (it needs a restored NuGet cache).

site.title: TDPdf
